messages:
ben: Heads-up — Prospect (EuroPay) wants a 10-day technical POC: strict EU-only processing, per-region sub-processor disclosure, and a clear fallback policy. They want pricing for a short Dedicated pool vs hosted with EU-preferred routing. Also flagged security Q10 about traces leaving EU. cc @emma @leah

emma: Noted. Need SAML org id + expected qps and avg token length to size Dedicated. Also: do they require HSM KMS or just customer-managed keys?

ben: SAML org id: EP-EU-77. Traffic: ~15 rps steady, bursts to 80 rps. Avg prompt+gen ~400 tokens. They said "prefer HSM" but will confirm.

leah: Legal: we can supply SCCs and a per-region sub-processor appendix. Hosted control-plane telemetry is global by default; we have an "EU-only telemetry" toggle but enabling it prevents automatic non-EU fallback. I'll add that to the contract addendum.

tom: Infra summary (short):
- Dedicated/Private: compute, logs, and metrics can be pinned to eu-west-1 or eu-central-1. No replication by default.
- Hosted: we route by policy: prefer EU regions, but if capacity exhausted we may fail over to another region unless eu-only-telemetry or deny-failover flags are set.

tom: Draft routing snippet for the POC runbook:
```yaml
routing:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  allowed_failover_regions: [] # empty => deny automatic failover
  failover_behavior: manual_approval # options: deny, manual_approval, auto_fallback
  telemetry_scope: eu-only
  subprocessor_disclosure: per-region
```

infra-bot: Quick cost note: Dedicated short-term 3xA100 pool ~ "€5.5k/week" (est). Hosted w/ EU-preferred routing run-rate ~ "€2.2k/week" + possible egress/replication risk if failover allowed. These are ballparks pending exact token counts.

sec-bot: Draft Q10 reply: "Dedicated/Private: application logs and request traces are stored in the selected EU region and are not replicated outside the EU unless customer authorizes replication. Hosted: control-plane telemetry is global by default; we offer an EU-only telemetry option that keeps telemetry within EU boundaries but will disable automatic cross-region failover. Full details: https://redwood-internal/security/telemetry-routing"

leah: Two legal follow-ups for the customer: 1) confirm vendor acceptability (we list Datadog EU, AWS/GCP/Azure EU tenants); 2) confirm HSM requirement — if HSM is required that may add ~2 weeks.

ben: Action items: 1) Emma: draft quote for Dedicated vs Hosted + include routing snippet and HSM timeline note; 2) Tom: short runbook for enabling EU-only telemetry and steps for manual failover; 3) Leah: sub-processor appendix and SCCs. I'll assemble and send POC package tomorrow. :thumbsup:

emma: On it. Will DM SAML test metadata request to Ben and include egress callout.

ben: Thanks everyone — moving to send later today once we get HSM confirmation from the customer."
